mobile.agent_avatar.edit_hint.note: Shown as a toast when the reader taps or long-presses the agent's picture in a conversation header, and read as that control's accessibility hint. The phone app cannot edit agent pictures; the Local Operator desktop app can. Keep "desktop app" generic (no product name). No final full stop.

mobile.agent_avatar.label.note: Accessible name of the agent's profile picture in a conversation header (a decorative picture that is also a button explaining where to change it). A noun phrase, not an action. "Agent" is the product term for the AI assistant the conversation runs. No final full stop.
